narrative.overview:
The site is the Xenia research archive of 1996, reopened today. It is stone-grey archive paper with index cards on it, graphite type, and one ink colour taken from the Siemens research labs: petrol. A second colour, coral, appears in a single role: the mark that says "Sie sind hier". The Stadtplan is still a real grid of districts set around a petrol centre. Every Viertel has a small line-drawn building on a pale petrol disc. A Rundgang is a row of those buildings you step along. The paper is warm, quiet and exact: hairline rules, precise mono labels, big serif numerals for years and sequences.

The map is the frame and the original Xenia text is the destination. Headings, large numerals and the source texts are set in book serifs. Interface words are set in a plain grotesque. Labels, counts and measurements are set in a monospace, like the stamps and shelf marks on archive cards. Density is low: generous margins, one main thing per view, and navigation that points the way without competing with the text.
keyCharacteristics: Warm stone-grey archive paper, graphite type and lines, petrol as the single strong colour.
Display serif for headings and large numerals, text serif for original texts, grotesque for interface, mono for labels and numbers.
Flat surfaces separated by hairlines and tints; the petrol Zentrum tile is the one inverted surface.
Line-drawn buildings on pale petrol discs identify every Viertel, Thema and the Stadtplatz.
Small, barely rounded controls (24–32px tall, 2–4px corners).

rules.name: The Petrol Rule
rules.body: Petrol marks what moves the visitor forward and the centre of the city: primary buttons ("Rundgang starten", "Kapitel 3 weiterlesen"), the Zentrum, completed progress, links and focus. It's never a section background.

rules.name: The Mist Rule
rules.body: Petrolschleier marks the guided way: illustration discs, the Stadtrundgänge band, the "Gangart wechseln" box, the current station, secondary buttons and badges. It's never used as a decorative background outside those roles.

rules.name: The Signal Rule
rules.body: Koralle appears once per view at most, and only as a mark for the current place. Never text, never a fill behind text, never a button.

rules.name: The Ink Rule
rules.body: Text and line art are Graphit. Grey text is Bleigrau, never lighter. On Petrolschleier, text is Tiefpetrol; on Petrol, text is white.

rules.name: The Source Text Rule
rules.body: Original Xenia texts are always set in Literata at 18px or larger, and interface copy never is. A reader can tell at a glance what is source and what is site.

rules.name: The Label Rule
rules.body: A heading gets at most one label row above it. Page titles carry an uppercase DM Mono eyebrow that names the place and its position ("VIERTEL 03", "RUNDGANG 02 · STATION 0–8 · CA. 20 MIN."); a Schibsted Grotesk 12px badge may sit next to it. Section headings carry a Schibsted Grotesk 500 14px section label. Cards may carry a mono meta line above their title.

rules.name: The Legend Rule
rules.body: DM Mono is for labels, counts, dates, durations and routes. It never carries prose or button labels. It stays at 12px on every breakpoint. Years and sequence numbers that are shown large are set in the display serif, not in mono.

rules.name: The Text Leads Rule
rules.body: On a reading page the text column is the widest thing on screen. When navigation competes with it, collapse the navigation.

rules.name: The Paper Rule
rules.body: Anything that's part of the page is flat. Only something that floats above the page (menu, popover, sheet, drawer) may cast a shadow. A border and a shadow never appear on the same element.

dos: Do set every original Xenia text in Literata at 18px or larger, in a column no wider than 608px.
Do use Petrol for what moves the visitor forward and Petrolschleier for the guided way. Nothing else gets those colours.
Do give every Viertel, Thema and the Stadtplatz its line-drawn building on a Petrolschleier disc. Reuse the existing illustration components rather than drawing new ones.
Do bind every colour to the Style and Mode variables, so every style mode and Light and Dark all work.
Do name places by their glossary names ("das Viertel der Kontexte"), and use numbers only where the sequence matters.
donts: Don't stack more than one label row above a heading.
Don't use DM Mono for prose or button labels.
Don't add shadows to cards, tiles or anything that sits on the page.
Don't use Koralle for text, fills or buttons, or more than once per view.
Don't use Schieferblau outside the illustrations.
Don't use a one-sided bar or border to highlight a quote or note. Use italics, a tint or a full border.
Don't number things that aren't a sequence, such as nav items.
